meta.title: OptimizeCV: from resume to interview invite
meta.description: AI reads your resume and the job description, scores your ATS match and suggests line-by-line edits that get you interviews.

home.eyebrow: For candidates in Vietnam and worldwide
home.title: Get your resume past the filters and into the interview
home.subtitle: Upload your resume, paste the job description. AI scores the match the way an ATS reads it, shows the skills you're missing and rewrites each bullet without inventing experience.
home.ctaNote: Works with Vietnamese and English resumes, PDF or DOCX

tailor.title: Tailor resume to a JD
tailor.body: ATS score, missing skills and bullet-by-bullet edits aligned with the job you're applying for.

role.body: Decode the JD: must-haves, nice-to-haves, interview rounds and the questions you're likely to get.

portfolio.title: Portfolio review
portfolio.body: Score your GitHub, website, Behance or PDF against the target role, with concrete improvements.

interview.title: Interview practice
interview.body: Mock interviews by chat or by voice like a real call, scored after every session.

result.questions: The AI needs you to clarify

formatIssue.missing_skills_section: No dedicated skills section, so an ATS may miss your skills.
formatIssue.missing_summary: No summary at the top of the resume.
formatIssue.low_metrics: Few bullets include measurable results (%, counts, revenue…).
formatIssue.long_bullets: Many bullets are too long to skim.
formatIssue.too_long: The resume is longer than the recommended 1–2 pages.
formatIssue.too_short: The resume is too short to evaluate well.
formatIssue.photo_international: The resume has a photo; many international markets (US, UK, Australia) advise removing it.
formatIssue.dob_international: The resume shows a date of birth; international markets usually advise removing it.

result.disclaimer: These are AI suggestions. Only put on your resume what is true about your real experience.
result.fillPlaceholders: Replace {placeholders} with your real numbers before exporting your resume.
result.exportBody: Apply the {count} changes you accepted, preview the result, then download it as PDF or Word.
result.exportEmpty: Accept suggestions above, then preview and download the revised resume as PDF or Word.
result.reupload: Upload a revised CV for this JD

analyze.savedJobsPlaceholder: Pick a JD you analyzed before…
analyze.savedJobFailed: Couldn't load this JD. Try again or paste the JD below.
analyze.comparingWith: Using a saved JD: {job}. If you keep the JD as it is, the result is compared with the previous analysis.

cv.title: Revised resume
cv.subtitle: Your resume with the suggestions you accepted, in a single-column ATS-friendly layout.
cv.noChanges: You haven't accepted any suggestions, so this matches your original resume.
cv.unfilled: {count} lines still have gaps like [X%] (highlighted in yellow). Click a line to fill in your real numbers before downloading.
cv.unplaced: {count} accepted suggestions couldn't be matched to a line in your resume, so they weren't applied. You can add them in the Word file.
cv.photoNote: The export has no photo or date of birth. If the employer asks for them, add them in the Word file.
cv.templateNote: The download uses a new layout, not your original design. Read it through before you apply.
cv.editTip: Click any line, including your name, phone number and dates, to edit it; press Enter to save. Clear a line to leave it out. Highlighting appears only in this preview: green for suggestion rewrites, blue for your own edits, yellow for gaps to fill.
cv.removed: Line removed. Click to restore it.
cv.saveFailed: Your last change wasn't saved. Check your connection and edit it again.
cv.reevaluateBody: Score the resume as previewed below, with the suggestions you accepted and your own edits, against the same JD.
cv.reanalyzeQuota: Re-analyzing with AI gives a new verdict and suggestions and uses 1 analysis ({remaining}/{limit} left this month). If the resume hasn't changed since your last re-analysis, you'll see that result again at no cost.
cv.reanalyzeUnlimited: Re-analyzing with AI gives a new verdict and suggestions.
cv.noChangesToAnalyze: Accept a suggestion or edit the resume before re-analyzing with AI.
cv.finishEditing: Save the line you're editing before re-evaluating.
cv.rescoreNote: The ATS score is computed by code, against the same JD and criteria as the first time. For a new verdict and suggestions, re-analyze with AI.
cv.reuploadHint: Downloaded the resume and edited it in Word or elsewhere?
cv.reupload: Upload the revised CV for this JD

portfolio.title: Portfolio review
portfolio.subtitle: AI reads your portfolio the way a hiring manager for this JD would: what works, what to fix and which projects to show first.
portfolio.githubHint: The AI looks at your profile and up to 6 notable repositories with their READMEs.
portfolio.urlsPlaceholder: One link per line, up to 3
portfolio.urlsHint: Pages built entirely with JavaScript (like Behance) often show very little; export a PDF instead.
portfolio.pdfHint: Up to 4 MB and 100 pages. The AI sees every page, images included.
portfolio.submitting: Reading and reviewing your portfolio, usually 1–2 minutes…

account.title: Account
account.usageNote: Usage counts per calendar month (UTC) and resets on the 1st.
account.dataBody: Download everything we store about you: parsed resumes, JDs, analysis results, suggestion choices, practice interviews and portfolio reviews.
account.deleteBody: Permanently delete your account with every resume, analysis, practice interview and portfolio review. This can't be undone. Original CV files are never stored.
account.deleteMismatch: That email doesn't match the signed-in account.

goodbye.title: Account deleted
goodbye.body: Your account and all of your data have been deleted. Thank you for using OptimizeCV.
